title: TIB-STC: A Large-Scale Structured Tibetan Dataset for Low-Resource Language Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating linguistic fidelity and cultural alignment by testing models on the Tibetan-specific Ti-MMLU benchmark (which includes region-specific and humanities tasks) and qualitatively comparing model responses to culturally sensitive prompts to check for appropriate traditional Tibetan stylistic and cultural representation.

Evaluating models using the Ti-SafetyBench benchmark, which includes a specific 'Unfairness and Bias (UB)' category comprising multiple-choice questions. Performance is scored using Direct Answer Calculation (DA) and Concern All Answer Calculation (CAA).
